title: Fun and entertaining discovery of Granada with teens.
text: Great fun! Very enjoyable for teens and grownups alike. We créa te s two teams to make it more competitive and the teens loved it! Not one complaint about being tired for about two and a half hours. Bliss! And to discover Granada in this way gives you a good overview of the city. Will definitely do it again in other places!
author: Marie_D

title: Super fun game for teens and grown ups discovering the center of Granada.
text:
Super duper fun! We had a wonderful time discovering Granada, which we didn’t know, with this scavenger hunt game. We created two teams competing against each other (parents vs kids) and it was really super entertaining. We had to use the clues once or twice but the difficulty level was perfect for teens and parents. What would be brilliant is to have a few questions at the end on the actual historical content to see what they retained from the mini guide at the start of each leg of the hunt. 
We’ll see if we can find out other ones in other cities. Keep it up!
author: MDKew

title: Well worth doing.
text: We thoroughly enjoyed the scavenger hunt although one or two  of the puzzles were so cryptic there was no way we were going to solve them without the clues. The City hall had us stumped, it was purely by chance we solved that one. We saw places in Granada we would not have gone to and learnt some of the historic facts we would have never known.
author: karensW8576FE

title: Educational city walk through Granada center
text: Done a World City Trail in multiple cities and it's always enjoyable. Educational and always a fun route. In Granada we started at the beautiful Cathedral which was immediately a highlight.
author: Marco_travel81
